problem_type: Parallel transport schema and authentication error boundaries
symptom: External clients receive incomplete lane schemas or inconsistent verified-client denial
direct_cause: Handwritten MCP field tables drift; stdio authenticates at startup while launcher authenticates on invoke; RPC drops typed code
class_root: Published semantics and verified-client refusal lack a shared enforcement boundary
affected_population: Claude Code and WorkBuddy stdio clients
Electron direct and packaged loopback MCP transports

external_sources.purpose: Object schema and tool execution error envelope

Invalid client proof is rejected before catalog or domain invocation with stable code
generality_proof: All MCP requests converge at createMcpProtocol; direct stdio defers identity minting to that boundary; loopback preserves its typed refusal. Composite schemas read the shared lane descriptors.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Publish shared semantic schema inside domain transport envelope
Reject invalid verified-client claims before protocol/domain work

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses createMcpProtocol and lazy verified session
Uses the same createMcpProtocol callback and verified connection factory

prevention.failure_mode: JSON-RPC -32001 data.code=mcp_connection_unauthenticated before any domain invocation
prevention.strategy: Shared protocol preflight plus same-source schema projection

legacy_paths.rationale: Delete hand-copied schema tables and eager process-exit authentication

exit_criteria: All published MCP schemas compile and validate through Ajv without mutation or unresolved references.

dependency_lifecycle.target: Ajv 8.20.0 direct runtime dependency with unchanged schema inputs
